posts.description: Riikee is a calm, full-screen writing space built around a simple idea: make writing every day feel inviting. Open it and start writing—no sign-up required. When you want more, AI can help you find a direction, shape an outline, continue, rewrite, adjust tone, and review expression without taking over your voice. Daily goals, streaks, archives, and an AI Writing Portrait turn scattered practices into a writing life you can see.

posts.name: Strategies
posts.tagline: Creative-prompt cards for music producers
posts.description: An iOS app with creative-prompt cards for music producers. Each card pairs two ideas at a controllable "cognitive distance," so the prompts stay sharp instead of blurring after the tenth one. A daily card, new set of cards monthly, a streak that unlocks real decks, and custom decks you author yourself. Works offline. EN + UA.

posts.name: LaunchUp Club
posts.tagline: Launch your startup. Get seen. Grow faster.
posts.description: LaunchUp is a startup discovery platform built to help founders get visibility, connect with other builders, and grow their network. Unlike traditional launch platforms focused on one-time exposure, LaunchUp gives startups a dedicated profile that can continue attracting attention over time. It combines startup discovery with a founder community, making it easier for new products to get noticed and for builders to connect.

posts.name: AuditStore
posts.tagline: Catch App Store rejections before Apple does
posts.description: AuditStore is a native macOS app that audits your App Store Connect submission against Apple's rules — before reviewers see it. Blocking / Review / Passed in one glance, each issue deep-linking to the exact fix. Your API key never leaves your Mac.

posts.name: higgs
posts.tagline: AI for your Proton Mail inbox, all on your machine
posts.description: higgs classifies, searches, and answers questions about your Proton Mail inbox with a local LLM. Everything runs on your machine through Proton Mail Bridge and Ollama: no cloud inference, no API keys, no telemetry. Open source, agent-first, written in Go.

posts.name: Clipses.ai
posts.tagline: Turn interview footage into findings people actually watch
posts.description: Clipses cuts down user interview admin so researchers spend more time on the research itself. Get ready to share highlight reels in minutes, with no video editing software required. Upload your interview recording, search the synced transcript by topic or meaning ("switching cost," "onboarding friction"), clip the moments that matter, pull matching quotes across sessions into one video reel, and share a link that plays anywhere.

posts.name: CodeContext+
posts.tagline: Relevant context stays visible while you develop.
posts.description: Developers spend hours writing code, but the reasoning behind it quickly disappears into pull requests, issues, chats, and documents. CodeContext+ keeps relevant context visible exactly where development happens, so architectural decisions, investigations, debugging history, and implementation rationale are available while you're reading and editing code instead of somewhere else.

posts.name: Google SERP Simulator
posts.tagline: Preview Google search snippets before you publish
posts.description: A Google SERP simulator for previewing title tags, meta descriptions, URLs, and review rich results. Measure truncation by rendered pixel width, compare desktop and mobile previews, and refine your metadata before publishing. No signup required.

posts.name: Lyria 3.5 by Google DeepMind
posts.tagline: Google DeepMind's next-gen AI music model
posts.description: Lyria 3.5 is Google DeepMind’s latest music generation model, designed to help creators explore new possibilities in sound. With improved musicality, lyric understanding, and creative control, Lyria 3.5 turns ideas into expressive, high-quality music. Whether you’re composing songs, experimenting with melodies, or bringing creative concepts to life, Lyria 3.5 makes music creation more accessible than ever.

posts.name: CodeContext+
posts.tagline: Relevant context stays visible while you develop.
posts.description: Developers spend hours writing code, but the reasoning behind it quickly disappears into pull requests, issues, chats, and documents. CodeContext+ keeps relevant context visible exactly where development happens, so architectural decisions, investigations, debugging history, and implementation rationale are available while you're reading and editing code instead of somewhere else.

posts.name: BitePad
posts.tagline: A minimalist calorie tracker for fast meal logging.
posts.description: BitePad is intentionally minimal. Instead of packing in bloated features, we focus on one thing: making calorie tracking fast and effortless. We avoid AI photo logging because it often misidentifies foods and requires manual corrections. Just speak or type what you ate, review the estimated calories and macros, make any quick edits, and log your meal in seconds. Simple by design, built for everyday use.

posts.name: Artificial Intelligence Jobs
posts.tagline: Every AI job worth having, curated and updated daily
posts.description: Aggregators re-list stale jobs. This pulls from the source: 17,000+ live AI roles scraped daily from 350+ company career pages, so listings stay current and filled ones drop off. AI-only, every function, not just engineering: research, product, GTM, marketing, ops, policy. Describe what you want in one line and it builds the search. Save roles without an account. Weekly digest, RSS, Telegram, free JSON API. Free, no signup, no paywall.

posts.name: Sheet Sync for Jira
posts.tagline: Scheduled Jira exports, straight to Google Sheets
posts.description: The official Jira Cloud for Sheets add-on still works but has been unreliable since the Dec 2024 API change, and most alternatives charge per user. Sheet Sync for Jira runs JQL or saved filters into Google Sheets with every field including custom ones, pages through full results instead of stopping at a cap, and refreshes hourly, daily or weekly. Flat US$20/month per Jira site. It runs in Apps Script - no vendor server touches your data.

posts.name: Juye: CRM for travel agencies
posts.tagline: Keep every client, trip and follow-up in one place
posts.description: Juye is a CRM built specifically for independent travel agents and small agencies. It brings clients, leads, trips, tasks and follow-ups into one simple workspace. Instead of managing customers across spreadsheets, notes and chats, agents can keep their workflow in one place. This is an early launch, and I’m looking for honest feedback on the design, UX and features as I continue building Juye.

posts.name: ClueSolver.io
posts.tagline: Free word-game solver: Wordle, Scrabble, crosswords & more
posts.description: ClueSolver.io combines four word-game tools in one place: a Wordle solver, Scrabble word finder, anagram generator, and crossword clue lookup — instead of bouncing between separate single-purpose sites for each. It runs on the full 172,000-word ENABLE dictionary and needs no login. Crossword clue pages include the answer, a difficulty rating, and a plain-English fun fact — not just a bare word list. Built solo, completely free, no paywall.

posts.name: 浮光面板 Flux Monitor
posts.tagline: Your Mac's control plane, local and remote
posts.description: A native macOS launcher, web dashboard, and mobile companion for monitoring and managing the Mac you own. Inspect system health, processes, ports, logs, Docker, Nginx, and LaunchAgents; use Flux Remote from iOS or Android when you are away.

posts.name: Vistree
posts.tagline: Reorganize markdown structure as a mindmap and re-export
posts.description: Vistree visualizes your markdown heading structure as a horizontal mindmap. Drag nodes to reorder sections, move them across heading depths (h2 becomes h3 automatically), and export clean markdown. Built for long markdown files, AI-generated docs, handoff memos, READMEs, where scrolling and manual cut-and-paste breaks your flow. Unlike read-only visualizers like Markmap, Vistree lets you restructure your document and get markdown back. No signup. No install. Runs in the browser.

posts.name: Signal Fifteen
posts.tagline: YC, a16z, 20VC podcasts turned into weekly startup ideas
posts.description: Problem: AI made it too easy to build the wrong thing. Solution: Signal Fifteen turns YC, a16z, 20VC, and top founder podcasts into evidence-backed startup ideas founders can save, explore, pressure-test, and start building in one click.

posts.name: ShipDR
posts.tagline: Maker-Proven Backlink Engine
posts.description: Track your Domain Rating free, then submit and track backlinks on maker-proven startup directories. Every listing verified: live, dofollow, indexed, still there. $10 once per website, no subscription.

posts.name: Prompt2Script - describe it, AI builds
posts.tagline: Describe a task, get a working Python script in minutes
posts.description: Describe a task in plain language and Prompt2Script does it all for you, returning a finished file in 5 minutes. No software to install, no hosting, no fixing the AI's mistakes. Start free.

posts.name: Fravash
posts.tagline: A digital ID that proves a real person is on the other side.
posts.description: A digital ID that proves a real person is on the other side. Built once from the chip in your ID, held on your phone, and answered without disclosing anything. Waitlist is open, sign up to get updates.

posts.name: ScentPass
posts.tagline: Discover, track, and finally understand your taste in scent
posts.description: ScentPass is a fragrance discovery and collection app. Browse an extensive catalog by olfactory family, season, or notes. Build your scent profile — the families you love, the occasions you wear scent for, your signature — so the next sommelier knows exactly where to start. Log everything you own, tried, or want. Rate with your own score next to the community's. Free on iOS and Android.

posts.name: ResellAIO
posts.tagline: Track inventory, sales & profit. built for resellers
posts.description: The complete inventory management platform designed for resellers. Track inventory, manage sales, monitor expenses, and maximize profits - all in one place.

posts.name: ProofPing
posts.tagline: Know the second your client opens your proposal
posts.description: ProofPing is a Chrome extension that tracks any link you send. Paste a URL, get a tracked link, and receive an instant email the moment your client opens it. Perfect for freelancers, agencies, and sales pros who hate guessing.

posts.name: Country Draw
posts.tagline: Draw countries from memory on a real map
posts.description: A free browser geography game that hides a country on a real map and asks you to reconstruct its border. Compare matched, missed, and extra areas, take a deterministic daily challenge, or practice 197 countries plus US, Canadian, Australian, and UK regions. No account required.

posts.name: SaveAnswer
posts.tagline: Save useful AI answers, then find them when you need them
posts.description: AI chats are useful until the answer you need disappears into a long history. SaveAnswer is a local Chrome extension for keeping the replies you actually want to reuse. Click Save next to a supported AI reply, add tags if useful, then search saved questions and answers later. Saved items stay in Chrome local storage. There is no account, remote backend, or cross-device sync yet.

posts.name: Ktisto
posts.tagline: Home construction & renovation tracking
posts.description: Ktisto logs expenses, payment installments, tasks, and suppliers for your home's construction or renovation — so you always know how much you've spent, how much you owe, and what's left of the project's cost.

posts.name: BuhoPilot
posts.tagline: The AI job search platform — discovery to interview prep
posts.description: BuhoPilot is an AI job search and resume builder platform for people tired of LinkedIn void applications. Build one solid resume, match it to each job description, track the companies you actually want, set alerts, draft outreach, and prep when something moves. Not another auto-apply spray tool — quality per application, from discovery to interview.
